text:
Ada: Heads up — live incident, some customers hitting 503s after the rule flip. It looks like the gateway started honoring X-Route-Priority header over route weights. :warning:
Ben: I see spikes in the telemetry dashboard for gateway-frontend between 22:13 and 22:16, correlated with the canary rollout.
Sasha: Is that the new precedence change we merged this morning? I thought default was still weight-first.
Ada: We merged a small tweak to header precedence to allow per-tenant overrides. It probably landed in the canary without enough guardrails.
Jamal: Repro in staging: set header `X-Route-Priority: high` and you bypassed ratelimit quotas and went to dedicated pool. Not great.
Lin: Rollback plan? We should be able to toggle the feature flag in the console, but we need to be careful about in-flight sessions.
Ada: Proposed quick plan: 1) flip `header-precedence` feature flag to off for prod via console toggle, 2) revert the canary rollout policy, 3) watch telemetry for 5m, 4) if stable, follow up with a small patch adding stricter header allowlist.
Ben: Agree. Who can flip the flag now? @deploy-bot do we have an automated toggle endpoint?
deploy-bot: Ada requested feature-flag toggle `header-precedence` -> OFF. Running safety checks: ok. TTL: 300s. Applying to prod canaries first.
Sasha: Wait — can canaries still push to dedicated pools? If the toggle rolls out canary-first, we might see partial traffic changes. Can we force a global override immediately?
Ada: I can run the admin kill-switch that forces route precedence to weight-only. Command: `adminctl route-priority override --mode=weights-only --apply-now`
Jamal: Run it in `--dry-run` first and paste output here. Also capture current route mapping: `curl -s http://gateway-admin/internal/routes?owner=prod`
Lin: I'm capturing traces now. If you run the override, ensure we also trigger an emergency metric annotation so paging doesn't miss it: add `incident_tag=hdr-precedence` to the annotation.
Ada: Dry-run output: `Status: OK; Affected routes: 128; Current override: none; Proposed: weights-only`. Looks safe. I'm applying now.
Ada: Applied `adminctl` override. deploy-bot: please annotate metrics and pin a short retention on logs for the next 1h.
deploy-bot: Override applied globally at 22:16:09 UTC. Metrics annotated with `incident=hdr-precedence`. Log retention pin set to 1h.
Ben: Telemetry shows 503s dropping to baseline within 30s. Nice. Quota hits restored to expected.
Sasha: Phew. Next steps: revert the merge or add a strict allowlist for `X-Route-Priority` to only the internal tenants.
Jamal: We should also add a canary gate that checks quota telemetry delta before promoting header-precedence to more clusters.
Lin: Filing a short postmortem and a follow-up ticket to add canary safety checks + console UX to show header overrides prominently.
Ada: I'll create the PR for the allowlist and add a console banner that warns when header-precedence is enabled.
Sasha: Also, add an eval in staging that simulates high-traffic tenants sending malformed header values — we missed that in tests.
Ben: Thanks everyone. Calling this contained. If anything flares up I’ll reopen the thread. :white_check_mark:
